headroom_note: PARSE_ORACLE (perfect parse) uplift is only +0.0221 F1 / +3 reader items (CITED@data/exp_reader_component_oracle_ablation_audit_v1/metrics.json). Any real adaptation captures a fraction of that already-tiny reader headroom; the arc proxy is the finer-grained parser-level signal.
scope_caveat: PROBE, not a capability claim. Self-training is the UNSUPERVISED in-domain adaptation lever (no gold, no train-on-test). It does NOT test a SUPERVISED in-domain gold-TREE fine-tune -- no McGuffey gold dependency trees exist; building them + fine-tuning is the scoped follow-up if this probe motivates it. uas_dev is UD-EWT dev (the parser's OWN in-domain); McGuffey UAS has no gold-tree reference, so arc_acc_present (gold argstruct arcs) is the in-domain proxy. LOCAL-ONLY, NOT banked, CLAIM-VET-pending.

robustness_dose_response.test: expand in-domain adapt corpus ~2.7x (Second+Third+Fourth McGuffey readers, 4721 silver from 2400 sents vs 1766 from 900); one variable = corpus size
robustness_dose_response.result: IDENTICAL outcome: uas_dev 0.7924 (vs 0.792), arc_acc_present 0.9524->0.9643 (+1 arc, same), reader rc 0.60->0.61 f1 0.4478->0.4535, net_recovered=1 (same item L04_14 hold/hands), net_regressed=0
robustness_dose_response.read: lift is STABLE + zero-regression + reproducible across 2 corpus sizes (NOT single-seed noise) but PLATEAUS at +1 arc / +1 reader item -- more in-domain data does not grow it. Parser arc-accuracy on the reader-relevant argument arcs is already ~0.95 (near-ceiling), so adaptation headroom is nearly exhausted.

honest_deflation: HARD_PASS fired per the pre-registered band (net_recovered>=1, net_regressed==0, uas not wrecked) and the direction is REAL + dose-response-stable, UNLIKE the algorithmic search/valency levers that HARD_FAILed. BUT effect size is TINY (+1 arc, +1 reader item, +~0.006 F1) and SATURATED. Practical fair verdict: 0.81 is NOT a hard fair ceiling (adaptation moves it a hair) but IS effectively a fair ceiling for reader-recall purposes -- 0.7882 is an ALL-ARCS UD-EWT figure; on the argument arcs the reader actually needs the parser already scores ~0.95, so PARSE is not the reader bottleneck. Consistent with the audit ranking ENUM (uplift +0.0527) above PARSE (+0.0221) as the top underperformer.
